description: This Python module implements a NotesService class that manages in-memory storage and business logic for a note-taking application. It provides thread-safe methods for creating, reading, updating, listing, and deleting notes, each represented by a dictionary with metadata such as timestamps.

classes.name: NotesService
classes.description: A service class managing in-memory notes with thread safety, providing methods for CRUD operations.

methods.name: None __init__(self)
methods.description: Initializes the NotesService instance with a threading lock, notes dictionary, and next ID counter.

methods.name: float _now_ts(self)
methods.description: Returns the current epoch timestamp with fractional seconds.

methods.name: List[Dict] list_notes(self)
methods.description: Returns all notes sorted by the most recently updated.

methods.name: Dict create_note(self, title: str, content: str)
methods.description: Creates a new note with a unique ID, title, content, and timestamps.

methods.name: Optional[Dict] get_note(self, note_id: int)
methods.description: Retrieves a note by its ID, or None if not found.

methods.name: Optional[Dict] update_note(self, note_id: int, title: Optional[str] = None, content: Optional[str] = None)
methods.description: Updates the title and/or content of an existing note, updating the timestamp.

methods.name: bool delete_note(self, note_id: int)
methods.description: Deletes a note by ID, returning True if successful.
